issues.title: The meta element redirects the user after more than 20 hours, which meets the 20-hour exception for WCAG 2.2.1.
issues.why_it_matters_for_persona: While automatic redirects can be disruptive for me as a keyboard-only user, a redirect that happens after more than 20 hours is extremely unlikely to interrupt my task. This long delay is considered acceptable under accessibility guidelines.
remediation_instructions: No remediation is needed as this is a passing case.
expected_tool_change: An automated accessibility tool should recognize the 20-hour exception and not flag this meta refresh as a failure.
